Dear Halcyon Payroll Services, Inc. team,

We are disputing the charges on Agreement No. {agreement}. The 3% annual increase was applied to our Monthly Service Fee beginning with invoice {invoices}, but the agreement does not allow it until {first_application}.

The agreement states: "{escalator_clause}"

The increase was applied from {applied_from}, which is earlier than the first permitted date. Under the agreement, the Monthly Service Fee is {contract_monthly}. We were billed {charged_monthly}, an overcharge of {overcharge_monthly} per month. The total overcharge to date is {overcharged_to_date}.

Please issue a credit for {overcharged_to_date} and send a corrected invoice. Going forward, please bill the Monthly Service Fee at {contract_monthly} until {first_application}, and apply the {escalator_pct} increase only from that date.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. Please confirm once the credit and corrected bill have been processed.

Best regards,
{sender}
